lines.text: Jesus tells believing Jews that continuing in His word makes them disciples, and the Son sets people free.
Jesus says they are trying to kill Him, and they answer that their only Father is Moses.
Jesus tells them their father is the devil, a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies.
The Jews call Jesus a Galilean with a demon, and they ask if He is greater than Abraham.
Jesus says before Abraham was born, I am, so they pick up stones, but Jesus is hidden and leaves.
